user.title: Drift: system
user.description: Pick the main ducted AC unit, the MyZone selector (Advantage Air) and the weather entity that provides an hourly forecast.

zones.title: Zone priorities
zones.description: Tier 1 is kept tightly in band (e.g. a child's bedroom). Tier 2 is next priority (e.g. the main bedroom). Tier 3 zones are allowed to drift further to save power.

data.tier1_sensor: Tier 1 room temperature sensor (optional, more accurate than the zone sensor)

energy.title: Energy and handover
energy.description: Optional: SolarEdge meter for solar/grid tracking. Automations listed here are switched off while Drift is enabled and back on when it's disabled.

data.ac_phase_power: Meter phase the AC is on (for learning AC power)

error.zone_is_main: Pick a zone, not the main unit.

abort.already_configured: This AC is already managed by Drift.

data.ac_phase_power: Meter phase the AC is on

tuning.title: Tuning
tuning.description: Bands and the overnight window are adjusted from the device page instead.

data.start_lag_minutes: Start lag (extra lead before a forecast breach)
data.precool_min_outdoor_c: Solar pre-cool only if forecast max ≥

tog.title: Sleepwear (TOG) chart
tog.description: Picking a TOG on the device page sets the tier 1 overnight band from this chart. Defaults follow common Australian sleepwear guidance; change them to match your brand.

data.tog_margin: Keep this far inside the chart range
data.notify_service: Notify service for the bedtime suggestion (e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone)
